coordinateConvention: Integer top-left original native raster pixels, end-exclusive [left,top,right,bottom). All pages are unrectified original sources. Body/spine rectangles are source-review ROIs rather than pixelwise semantic masks.
coverage: All three pages lie outside the previous12 real-source replay pages.

Untouched original gray pixels, faint/broken lines, thick lines, curvature/skew, tied/slurred heads, beamed notes, separate accidentals, six wrong-head/spine associations, barline/staff-line and tie junctions.
Positive body ROI centers are between -0.16 and1.42 locally measured staff spaces inward from an outer line.
limitations: The36 cases were selected by source inspection, not randomly sampled and not statistically independent.
T-H03/T-H04 are two heads of one chord on one shared stem. S-F01/S-F04 share a phrase/beam. Six wrong-spine negatives deliberately reuse positive head ROIs.
T-H04 is a genuine interior body on a continuing stem, not its terminal head; helper eligibility must distinguish this.
No confirmed real musical single spine crossing two complete staff cores found; do not infer a two-core native preservation pass from ordinary head recognition.
Exact outline pixels of a head cannot be separated semantically from crossing staff pixels by these rectangular source obligations.

realLongSpineSource.finding: A genuine two-hollow-head chord shares a downward stem across one complete upper Piano staff core; source y≈985..1070. The next staff begins≈1120, so this is not a two-core musical spine.

evaluationContract.positives: Count an accepted source body only if the reported witness actually belongs to the selected genuine head and tested own stem; report acceptance elsewhere on the stem separately. Record source-envelope preservation separately from helper recognition.
evaluationContract.negatives: Do not transfer ownership to the tested barline through a staff line or from a detached neighboring head/curve. Source-negative classification does not authorize deleting those musical marks.
evaluationContract.scope: Ordinary own-stem recognition validates source shape/attachment evidence. It is not proof that the full native long-connector path tests that stem or preserves every note.
